What kind of antennas?
They are antennas for satellite broadcasting.
Signals reach all the way to space and broadcast everywhere at once.

lines.trans: That is amazing.
With that, the dream I have chased all along might finally come true.

Exactly. We gain genuine freedom without ridiculous restrictions.
Will my next film shower down from outer space too?
Of course. That is what the satellite is for.

meanings.note: Special reading きょう.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Read なん before だ/です/の, and なに before が/を or alone.

examples.text: 何を買いにきましたか。
examples.trans: What did you come to buy?

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

examples.text: アンテナを使って電波を宇宙に飛ばすんです。
examples.trans: You use giant antennas to beam radio waves straight up into space.

examples.text: そうです。この巨大アンテナから飛んだ電波を衛星がキャッチするんです。
examples.trans: That's right. Orbiting satellites catch the waves beamed from these giant antennas.

examples.text: でっかいアンテナ。圧倒された。
examples.trans: Giant antennas. They completely blew me away.

examples.text: でっかいアンテナ。圧倒された。
examples.trans: Giant antennas. They completely blew me away.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Attaches to the irrealis (a-stem) of godan verbs.

examples.trans: I was called by the teacher.

meanings.note: In casual speech, それ plus は often fuses into そりゃ ('well, as for that / of course').

examples.text: 近い将来爆発的に普及する衛星放送についてご存じですか？
examples.trans: Have you heard of satellite broadcasting, which will soon spread explosively?

examples.text: 衛星放送っていうのはどういうもんなんですか？
examples.trans: Just what kind of thing is satellite broadcasting?

examples.text: 衛星放送のチャンネルを一つ持てば、何でも好きに放送できるんです。
examples.trans: If you hold just one satellite channel, you can broadcast whatever you please.

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).
Colloquial particle adding emphasis, similar to でも or も.

examples.text: 俺だって言いたいことがある。
examples.trans: I have something I want to say too.

examples.text: 誰だって間違いはある。
アンテナを使って電波を宇宙に飛ばすんです。
examples.trans: You use giant antennas to beam radio waves straight up into space.

examples.text: そう、宇宙です。私は夢のあるビジネスには融資を惜しみません。
examples.trans: Yes, outer space. I never hold back financing on a business with a big dream.

meanings.en: nothing more than (after past verb); up to
meanings.note: After a plain verb + です (出店したまでです), modestly states 'we simply did that and nothing more'.

examples.text: 念のため聞いたまでです。
examples.trans: I merely asked just in case.

examples.text: アンテナを使って電波を宇宙に飛ばすんです。
examples.trans: You use giant antennas to beam radio waves straight up into space.

examples.text: ここから電波が飛ぶんですか？
examples.trans: Radio signals fly into space right from here?

examples.text: そうです。この巨大アンテナから飛んだ電波を衛星がキャッチするんです。
examples.trans: That's right. Orbiting satellites catch the waves beamed from these giant antennas.

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

examples.text: 実はな、規制委員会からこんなものが届いてな。
examples.trans: Actually, a notice like this arrived from the regulation committee.

examples.text: 通達は届いてますよね？
examples.trans: You received our official notice, didn't you?

examples.text: ああ、あの脅しの紙ですか？あれなら何枚も届いてますよ。
examples.trans: Oh, you mean that threat letter? Plenty of copies of that arrived.

meanings.note: Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

examples.text: その日が来たら一週間はバラエティ番組の放送を見送らせる。
examples.trans: When that day arrives, networks will suspend variety broadcasts for one week.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.

examples.text: 古谷さんと手組んで、うちの作品を裏で流す。
examples.trans: Team up with Furuya and distribute our films underground.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Evidential auxiliary adjective expressing hearsay or inference.

examples.text: 百万冊以上売れてるらしい。
examples.trans: Apparently it sells over a million copies.

meanings.note: Plain い-adjective.

examples.text: 彼の英語は本当にすごい。

meanings.note: Points to something visible farther away from both speaker and listener.

examples.trans: That over there is a school.

meanings.note: Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.

meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.
Short for かもしれない; expresses possibility or uncertainty.
Ichidan verb; most commonly appears in the set expression かもしれない ('might be').

examples.text: 遅れるかもしれません。
本当かもしれませんよ。
examples.trans: It might be true, you know.

meanings.note: Noun.

examples.text: 今日は空がとても青いですね。
examples.trans: The sky is very blue today, isn't it?
Birds are flying in the sky.

examples.text: 大丈夫です。次は必ず空からエロが降ってくる時代が来ます。
examples.trans: Don't worry. Next, an era is coming when entertainment will rain straight down from the sky.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: in that way; that is so
meanings.note: そうですか ('Is that so? / I see') calmly acknowledges news.

examples.text: そうですか、わかりました。
そう。バカげた制約のない本物の自由が手に入る。
examples.trans: Exactly. We gain genuine freedom without ridiculous restrictions.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Compound of 本 (true) + 物 (thing); opposite of 偽物.

examples.trans: It looks just like the real thing.

meanings.note: Godan verb: potential polite 入れます (はいれます) means 'can enter'.

examples.text: 予約なしでも入れますか。
examples.trans: Can we get in without a reservation?

meanings.note: Standard gender-neutral 'I' in polite and business Japanese.
Used with の to modify the following noun (次のお二人様, 次の駅).

examples.trans: I get off at the next station.

meanings.note: Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

examples.text: そして今度は衛星から地球に電波が降り注ぐ。
examples.trans: And then the signals shower back down from the satellite onto the earth.

examples.text: 私の次の作品も宇宙から降り注ぐんですか？
examples.trans: Will my next film shower down from outer space too?

meanings.note: Confident everyday word that works either before a predicate or as a standalone answer.

examples.text: もちろん手伝いますよ。

meanings.en: that (near the listener or just mentioned)
meanings.note: Must always precede a noun (その椅子 'that chair').

examples.text: そうです。この巨大アンテナから飛んだ電波を衛星がキャッチするんです。
examples.trans: That's right. Orbiting satellites catch the waves beamed from these giant antennas.

examples.text: そして今度は衛星から地球に電波が降り注ぐ。
examples.trans: And then the signals shower back down from the satellite onto the earth.

examples.text: もちろん。そのための衛星だ。
examples.trans: Of course. That is what the satellite is for.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Contracts では; launches a decision ('well then') or opens casual farewell じゃあね.
Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
